notes.title: BandRoll is released in early access on Steam! 🥳
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43351245/d32c5f14547a83288ce1be92da74d71cf8e49b1a.png[/img]

Hi, everyone! 🙌
We are happy to announce that our game is in early access on Steam! 🥳

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2206390/BandRoll/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

Feel the Neon in Your Bones!

How would you like to experience your favorite genre of music in a new and exciting way? BandRoll creates an awesome mix of captivating gameplay and gorgeous visuals for you to play as you listen to songs you like.

[url=https://discord.gg/E7RXsHcppA][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43347835/fcf474262240c9eaa6fa41454946f9341ea19e1e.png[/img][/url][url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/41519224][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43347835/af6324e0d6200e3888c1a58847a16ad4dff2a23e.jpg[/img][/url]

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on our page.
We can’t wait to release the full version. 🚀

Hope that you can try our game and give us your feedback! 🤓

notes.title: 🎵Rhythm Gods🎵
notes.content:
We are excited to write down our first blog. We have been working on our game for a while and it will be 
available for you to try on Steam Next Fest 6 February 2023.

You’ll also be able to join the developer stream on February 6th, 2023. We are humbled by your continuous support from day one.

The platform flows to the rhythm of the music and the player slides. Train your reflexes in a 3D neon universe trying not to fall! You can experience different styles of music with a fluent visuality, and you can play different levels according to your musical tastes.

Take your rhythm taste to a different point with BandRoll! Finish the music and collect points to unlock new levels. While doing all this, improve your reflexes and focus ability.

That’s enough for today’s blog, we would like to see all of you on Steam Next Fest. We can’t wait to bring the full version.

Our Discord server is ready here for you to jump in if you would like to reach us directly.

Don’t forget to add to your wishlist, stay tuned!
